evals.prompt: Create a policy that lets my agent (user tag 'agent') sign transactions with wallet wlt_abc123.
evals.expected_output: EFFECT_ALLOW with consensus targeting agent tag, condition scoped to activity.action == 'SIGN' AND wallet.id. Asks human for confirmation before creating.

evals.prompt: Create a policy that allows my agent to sign any transaction.
evals.expected_output: Should warn that an unscoped signing ALLOW is dangerous and recommend adding wallet.id scope. Should NOT produce an ALLOW with only activity.action == 'SIGN' and no wallet scope.

evals.prompt: Set a spending limit of 0.5 ETH per transaction for all users.
evals.expected_output: Creates a DENY policy with condition eth.tx.value > 500000000000000000 (0.5 ETH in wei). No consensus (applies to all).

evals.prompt: Create one policy that allows signing with either wallet wlt_123 OR private key pk_456.
evals.expected_output: Should warn about the no-short-circuit rule and recommend splitting into two separate policies instead of using || between wallet.id and private_key.id

evals.prompt: My agent's transaction was denied. The activity ID is act_xyz789. Help me figure out why.
evals.expected_output: Uses get_policy_evaluations with the activity ID to retrieve the evaluation trace

evals.prompt: Create a policy that only allows my agent to send ETH to addresses 0xAAA and 0xBBB on Base (chain ID 8453).
evals.expected_output: EFFECT_ALLOW with address allowlist using 'in' syntax and chain_id condition

evals.prompt: Set a spending limit of 1 ETH. Use a value of 1 for the cap.
evals.expected_output: Should correct the user — eth.tx.value is in wei, not ETH. 1 ETH = 1000000000000000000 wei. Using 1 would block transfers above 1 wei.

evals.prompt: I want to restrict my agent's Solana transactions to only the System Program. Also block any transactions that use address table lookups.
evals.expected_output: Two policies: ALLOW with program_keys restriction, DENY with address_table_lookups.count() > 0

evals.prompt: Require that two users with the 'admin' tag approve any signing request above 1 ETH.
evals.expected_output: ALLOW with consensus using filter + count >= 2 on admin tag, condition on eth.tx.value
